steps: Chemistry is a vast subject and includes a large number of facts, concepts and processes.
Its branches make the subject easier to study and understand by grouping related topics together.
Each branch allows specialised study of a particular area and its applications.
items.finalAnswer: Chemistry is divided into branches because it is vast, the division makes it easier to study, and it enables specialised study of its different areas.

steps: Reactions involving electrons outside the nucleus are studied in ordinary chemistry.
Reactions taking place inside the nucleus are studied in nuclear chemistry.
items.finalAnswer: Ordinary chemistry studies reactions involving electrons outside the nucleus; nuclear chemistry studies reactions inside the nucleus.

steps: Analytical chemistry deals with the identification of substances and the determination of their composition.
It solves qualitative problems (what substances are present) and quantitative problems (how much of each substance is present).
items.finalAnswer: Analytical chemistry identifies the substances present in a sample and determines their amounts.

steps: Graphite consists of many layers of carbon atoms arranged in hexagonal patterns.
Graphene is a single layer of carbon atoms arranged in a hexagonal pattern.
items.finalAnswer: Graphite has many hexagonal layers, whereas graphene is a single hexagonal layer of carbon atoms.

steps: A supercritical fluid forms above a substance's critical temperature and critical pressure.
It has properties of both liquids and gases, so it can act as an effective solvent.
Supercritical fluids are important for processes such as extracting substances and can be used as alternatives to conventional solvents.
items.finalAnswer: Supercritical fluids are useful solvents for extraction and other processes because they combine properties of liquids and gases.

steps: Matter in the Sun exists in the plasma state.
Graphene is a very strong, lightweight and flexible form of carbon.
It conducts electricity and heat very well.
These properties make it useful in electronic devices and other advanced materials.
items.finalAnswer: Graphene is important because it is strong, light, flexible and an excellent conductor, making it useful in advanced materials and electronics.

steps: Most material things in the world belong to the solid state of matter.
